items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He had one guy that used to live here called Stuff Crouch... He put him in business, gave him an after-hour place.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Some (Unintelligible) musicians used to take him, like, for a fool. They thought he was a fool. But he used to tell me, he said, "Pops," he said, "them characters think I don't know," he said, "but I just give them poor so and so a few dollars."
Money didn't bother him. That's funny. And he had women strung all over the world, put them in business, even. He had one guy that used to live here called Stuff Crouch, Crotch, Crouch?
Stuff Crouch, Julius Crouch, yes, uh-huh.
